data_code_config_lineage: queries: Autocallable Phoenix, Phoenix Securities, worst performing, Autocallable contingent coupon, Phoenix coupon barrier
blockers: Full 1,000-document download and parsing are pending.
Term sheets do not supply realized outcome labels by themselves.
required_pipeline: Parse structured terms and compute SHA-256.
Join validated terms to as-of market data and lifecycle outcomes.
Re-run chronological OOS and baseline comparison before any promotion.
acceptance_tests: All downloaded documents have hash and retrieval timestamp.
Validated extraction accuracy exceeds 95% on the review subset.
No production weights, verdicts or trades change.
committee_review.next_experiment: Run the full 1,000-document download/parse pipeline, then evaluate extraction quality before model integration.
committee_review.final_devin_validation: Catalog and model-impact assessment recorded; no model integration or production mutation performed.
